Hormuz Dash

Take your tanker into the Gulf, load crude or LNG at a terminal, then run it out through the Strait of Hormuz to the Arabian Sea and sell it. Iran will try to stop you.

THE RUN

  • LoadSlow down inside a terminal ring until the tanks fill.
  • RunCross the Gulf and slip through the Strait.
  • SellReach the Arabian Sea at the east edge.

WHAT IRAN FIRES

  • Ballistic missilesLand fast where you are heading. Get out of the red circle right away.
  • Cruise missilesAimed at where you are heading. Change course or speed and it misses.
  • DronesSlower than you. One blinks red, then dives at where you are heading: turn hard as it dives.
W speed up · S brake, keep holding to reverse · A D turn · let go to drift Drag up to go, down to brake or reverse, sideways to turn
